title: Valerie Ransone, the Ether Ship group and the White House
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Valerie Ransone, the Ether Ship group and the White House, about 1970s at Washington, D.C., and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: She was like trying to communicate with aliens through xenol linguistics through uh she there was this group called the ether ship. This guy Willard de Bogart and um she was in the White House actually.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a woman named Valerie Ransone tried to communicate with aliens through xenolinguistics, the study of how to understand alien languages. He says she was involved with a group called the Ether Ship, connected to a man named Willard de Bogart, and that she actually worked in the White House in the 1970s. If true, it would mean attempts at alien contact reached the heart of the US government.
